issues.body: bench_egress_push is only called in the final loop after all materialization/HDT work. If the self-terminating box dies after producing an earlier envelope but before reaching this loop, that completed result is never sent to S3. The same deferred pattern exists in canonical-beir-gather-instance.sh. This contradicts scripts/bench/README.md and launcher comments claiming each envelope is uploaded as produced and that completed work survives termination mid-run. The test merely greps for bench_egress_push, so it passes even when the call is too late to provide the advertised durability.
issues.fix_hint: Call bench_egress_push immediately after each envelope is successfully written and JSON-validated in both the materialization and BEIR gather flows; keep or remove the final sweep as a retry. Add a hermetic behavioral test that stops the gather after the first completed envelope and verifies the AWS stub recorded that upload, instead of checking only that the function name appears.
issues.title: Completed envelopes are not uploaded until the entire gather finishes

verdict.summary: Round 2 fixes both prior major findings: bare --dry-run now avoids STS and has a hermetic assertion, while instance-profile attachment now queries the current role and tests same-role and conflicting-role reruns. However, the new durable-egress contract is still not implemented on the real BEIR and materialization paths. Their gather scripts defer all uploads until the final envelope-enumeration loop, despite the README and launcher comments promising upload as each envelope is produced and survival of mid-run termination. The wiring-only test cannot detect this. Because this is a new major finding despite resolution of the prior findings, progress is regressing under the required scale.
